name: Env vars
summary: API keys sit in environment variables or a .env file that the agent's process reads. It is the default for local tools and the MCP spec's recommendation for stdio servers, but every process the agent spawns can usually read them too.
how: Put keys in .env or the shell environment
The harness or MCP server reads them at start
Tools send them with each API call
facts: MCP: stdio servers should get credentials from the environment
Most local MCP servers and CLIs
Zero setup, but long-lived keys that the agent can read and leak
goodFor: Single-user tools on your own machine
watchOut: A shell command like env or cat .env puts the key in the model's context
Keys are long-lived and usually over-scoped
